name: gwF

args.name: pi
args.description: Equilibrium frequencies, keyed by alphabet symbol

title: Generalized frequency weighting
description: Attaches equilibrium frequencies to an exchangeability matrix using off-diagonal rates Q(i,j) = s(i,j) * pi[i]^(f-1) * pi[j]^f, where s is the exchangeability matrix. At f=1 this has the +F form; at f=0 rates are proportional to the inverse source frequency. Unlike F, this modifier does not scale the matrix to mean rate 1.
